demos.title: Model variants
demos.text:
MuScriptor model variants (weights are CC BY-NC 4.0, gated on Hugging Face):
  small  ~103 M params, 14 layers, dim  768  MuScriptor/muscriptor-small
  medium ~307 M params, 24 layers, dim 1024  MuScriptor/muscriptor-medium
  large  ~1400M params, 48 layers, dim 1536  MuScriptor/muscriptor-large

demos.title: Known tunings

  drop-c [36 43 48 53 57 62]

demos.title: Everything at once
demos.why: The happy path from the acceptance criteria: one command, MIDI + Guitar Pro + MusicXML + ASCII tab + the intermediate IR.
demos.command: mtab transcribe samples/showcase/audio/excerpt.wav --size large --weights /home/runner/work/_temp/weights/muscriptor-large.safetensors --max-gen-len 2000 -o /home/runner/work/mtab/mtab/samples/showcase/output/full.gp5,/home/runner/work/mtab/mtab/samples/showcase/output/full.musicxml,/home/runner/work/mtab/mtab/samples/showcase/output/full.mid,/home/runner/work/mtab/mtab/samples/showcase/output/full.txt --tuning auto --capo auto --dynamics --techniques --chords --emit-ir /home/runner/work/mtab/mtab/samples/showcase/output/full.ir.json

demos.title: Greedy decoding, strict EOS
demos.why: The deterministic default: no sampling, fail loudly if a chunk never emits EOS. Same flags twice must give identical bytes.
demos.note: Expected: strict EOS refuses a chunk that runs past the token budget instead of silently truncating the notes.

demos.title: Beam search
demos.why: Wider search over the same chunk, at a multiple of the decode cost.

demos.title: Seeded sampling
demos.why: Temperature sampling is deterministic given --seed, so a sample is reproducible without being greedy.

demos.title: Fixed tuning and capo
demos.why: Skip detection and fretting for a drop-D guitar with a capo at fret 2.
demos.command: mtab transcribe samples/showcase/audio/excerpt.wav --size large --weights /home/runner/work/_temp/weights/muscriptor-large.safetensors --max-gen-len 2000 -o /home/runner/work/mtab/mtab/samples/showcase/output/tuning.gp5 --tuning drop-d --capo 2 --format gp5

demos.title: Unquantized timing
demos.why: Raw model timing with no grid at all, for rubato passages that a fixed grid would flatten.
demos.command: mtab transcribe samples/showcase/audio/excerpt.wav --size large --weights /home/runner/work/_temp/weights/muscriptor-large.safetensors --max-gen-len 2000 -o /home/runner/work/mtab/mtab/samples/showcase/output/raw.mid --grid off --format midi

demos.title: Detected tempo, not a fixed grid
demos.why: Beat tracking instead of a constant BPM: MIDI keeps the rubato rather than snapping to a grid.

demos.title: Machine-readable notes
demos.why: The same decode as JSON Lines, one NoteEvent per line, for downstream tooling.

demos.title: Determinism
demos.why: Same audio, weights and --seed, run twice: byte-identical output is required by §6.14.6.

demos.title: Actionable failure
demos.why: A malformed audio file: the error names the problem and the next step, as §6.4 requires.
